terminals.description:
Terminals offered to the student, in display order.
+kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16

web.description:
Web endpoints inside the instance proxied to the student's browser.
+optional
+kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16

ide.description:
IDE runs a browser IDE (openvscode-server) on a machine.
+optional

Access.description: Access defines how the student reaches the machines.

url.description:
URL of the author (website, GitHub profile...).
+optional

ChallengePackage.description: ChallengePackage is the manifest of a challenge (challenge.yaml).

title.description: Title is the human-readable name of the challenge.

summary.description: Summary is a one or two sentence pitch shown in the catalog.

category.description: Category is the topic of the challenge.

estimatedTime.description:
EstimatedTime is how long a student typically needs, e.g. "30m".
+optional

tags.description:
Tags are free-form keywords used for search.
+optional

license.description:
License is the SPDX identifier of the challenge license, e.g. "MIT".
+optional

permissions.description:
Permissions declares what the challenge needs from the cluster. They are
shown to the admin at install time and checked against cluster policy.
+optional

lifetime.description:
Lifetime bounds how long an instance lives.
+optional

machines.description:
Machines that make up one instance of the challenge.
+kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16

extraManifests.description:
ExtraManifests are paths (relative to the package root) of Kubernetes
manifests applied in the instance namespace. Only namespaced resources
are allowed. Prefer machines: use this as an escape hatch.
+optional

access.description: Access defines how the student reaches the machines.

validation.description:
Validation configures how tasks are checked.
+optional

tasks.description:
Tasks are the gradable objectives of the challenge.
+kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=64

ChallengePackageSpec.description: ChallengePackageSpec describes a challenge: what it is about, the machines it runs on, how students access them, and the tasks to solve.

shell.description:
Shell runs a command on the machine.
+optional

file.description:
File asserts properties of a file on the machine.
+optional

sshLogin.description:
SSHLogin attempts an SSH login from the checker (vm and sysbox machines).
+optional

port.description:
Port probes a port from the checker.
+optional

http.description:
HTTP sends a request from the checker.
+optional

kubeCEL.description:
KubeCEL evaluates a CEL expression over objects of a vcluster machine.
+optional

goss.description:
Goss runs a goss spec on the machine.
+optional

exists.description:
Exists is whether the file must exist. Defaults to true.
+optional

mode.description:
Mode is the expected octal permission mode, e.g. "0600".
+optional

owner.description:
Owner is the expected owner, "user" or "user:group".
+optional

contains.description:
Contains is a regular expression the content must match.
+optional

notContains.description:
NotContains is a regular expression the content must not match.
+optional

FileCheck.description: FileCheck asserts properties of a file.

spec.description: Spec is the path of the goss YAML file, relative to the package root.

GossCheck.description: GossCheck runs a goss spec on a machine.

path.description:
Path of the request. Defaults to "/".
+optional

expectStatus.description:
ExpectStatus is the expected status code. Defaults to 200.
+optional

expectBody.description:
ExpectBody is a regular expression the body must match.
+optional

HTTPCheck.description: HTTPCheck sends an HTTP request from the checker.

cost.description:
Cost in points deducted when the hint is revealed.
+kubebuilder:validation:Minimum=0
+optional

Hint.description: Hint is a clue a student can reveal.

machine.description: Machine the IDE runs on. Cannot be a vcluster machine.

resource.description: Resource selects the objects to evaluate.

all.description:
All passes when the expression is true for every selected object (and at least one is selected).
+optional

any.description:
Any passes when the expression is true for at least one selected object.
+optional

none.description:
None passes when the expression is false for every selected object.
+optional

KubeCELCheck.description: KubeCELCheck evaluates a CEL expression on Kubernetes objects.

default.description:
Default lifetime of a new instance. Defaults to 1h.
+optional

max.description:
Max is the maximum lifetime, extensions included. Defaults to 3h.
+optional

Lifetime.description: Lifetime bounds how long an instance lives.

name.description: Name of the machine, unique in the package (DNS-1123 label).

runtime.description: Runtime is the isolation technology the machine runs on.

image.description:
Image is a container image (pod, sysbox) or a KubeVirt containerDisk
image (vm). Pin it by digest. Not used by vcluster.
+optional

setup.description:
Setup lists scripts (paths relative to the package root) run once as
root at provisioning, in order. Not supported by vcluster: use seed.
+optional

kubernetes.description:
Kubernetes is the version of the virtual cluster, e.g. "1.34" (vcluster only).
+optional

seed.description:
Seed lists manifest files or directories (paths relative to the package
root) applied into the virtual cluster at provisioning (vcluster only).
+optional

kubeconfigFor.description:
KubeconfigFor injects into this machine a kubeconfig for the named
vcluster machine.
+optional

Machine.description: Machine is one unit of an instance (a pod, system container, virtual cluster or virtual machine).

MachineResources.description: MachineResources are the resources requested by a machine.

name.description: Name is the package name: lowercase letters, digits and '-' (DNS-1123 label).

version.description: Version is a semantic version (https://semver.org), e.g. "1.2.0".

egress.description:
Egress is the outbound network access the instance needs. Defaults to "none".
+optional

egressAllowlist.description:
EgressAllowlist lists the host names reachable when egress is "allowlist".
+optional

Permissions.description: Permissions declares what a challenge needs from the cluster.

protocol.description:
Protocol of the probe. Defaults to "tcp".
+optional

expect.description: Expect is the expected state of the port.

PortCheck.description: PortCheck probes a port from the checker.

platform.description:
Platform is a semantic version constraint on the platform version, e.g. ">=0.3.0".
+optional

Requirements.description: Requirements lists compatibility requirements of a package.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion of the objects, e.g. "v1" or "apps/v1".

namespace.description:
Namespace of the objects. Empty selects all namespaces (or cluster-scoped objects).
+optional

expect.description: Expect is whether the login must be allowed or denied.

SSHLoginCheck.description: SSHLoginCheck attempts an SSH login from the checker.

run.description: Run is the command, executed with /bin/sh -c.

user.description:
User running the command. Defaults to "root".
+optional

expectExit.description:
ExpectExit is the expected exit code. Defaults to 0.
+optional

expectOutput.description:
ExpectOutput is a regular expression stdout must match.
+optional

ShellCheck.description: ShellCheck runs a command on a machine.

id.description: ID of the task, unique in the package (DNS-1123 label).

points.description:
Points awarded when the task is solved.
+kubebuilder:validation:Minimum=0

hints.description:
Hints the student can reveal, in order.
+optional
+kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=8

check.description:
Check evaluated by the built-in checker. Required unless the package
uses a custom checker image.
+optional

machine.description: Machine the terminal opens on. Cannot be a vcluster machine.

user.description:
User the shell runs as. Defaults to "student".
+optional

label.description:
Label shown on the terminal tab. Defaults to the machine name.
+optional

Terminal.description: Terminal is a shell offered to the student.

mode.description:
Mode controls when tasks are checked. Defaults to "on-demand".
+optional

interval.description:
Interval between automatic checks (auto mode only). Defaults to 30s, minimum 10s.
+optional

checkerImage.description:
CheckerImage is a custom checker image. When empty, the built-in checker
evaluates each task's check.
+optional

Validation.description: Validation configures how tasks are checked.

WebEndpoint.description: WebEndpoint is an HTTP service inside the instance shown to the student.
